rule: When every raw adjacent point pair uniquely forms a distinct valid wall event, pair-local min(y)/max(y) defines ceiling/floor regardless of recorded direction; raw-order pairing precedes unordered matching and circular handling changes only x representation.

c1_calculation_orphan_point_repair.scope: C1 derived Q_GT, peer, and LOO geometry calculations only
c1_calculation_orphan_point_repair.rule: For an odd-point submission, enumerate every single-point deletion using only submitted geometry. Apply the repair only if exactly one deletion yields an even-point, uniquely paired, topologically valid, non-self-intersecting geometry. Retain the raw submission and an audit of point counts, dropped index, rule version, and raw/repaired hashes.
not_allowed: using GT, worker identity, worker ranking, peer geometry, or outcome values to choose the dropped point
repairing incomplete pairs, multiple extra points, or ambiguous candidate deletions
erasing a confirmed worker-caused structural failure from F_struct
changing T1 or V1 delivery-adjusted failure handling
